new_map_solara.theme: Portside resort town, subtropical scenery, twin peaks, canyons, waterfalls, jacaranda trees

key_locations.description: Movie set-themed zone featuring two moving steam trains running toward each other in the center
Symmetrical research facility with mirrored slides for high-speed rotational positioning
Central S-shaped bend road lined with jacaranda trees
Wastewater treatment facility covered in yellow pipes providing concealed tactical routes

unique_map_mechanics.slides_and_stations: Enables rapid terrain traversal across the entire map
unique_map_mechanics.slide_gloo_wall_protection: Players can deploy special surrounding Gloo Walls while riding slides
unique_map_mechanics.enemy_proximity_warning: Slides flash red when hostile targets are nearby
